title: Stationary phase and symbols with derivative loss
source_hypothesis: Fixed 1/2<rho<=1, delta=1-rho; real homogeneous phases, compact interior normalized supports, uniformly nondegenerate normal Hessians and proper actual critical support. Global quotient assumes a globally closed embedded conic Lagrangian; open-cone versions are microlocal on compact normalized subsets.
component_scope: Full stationary symbol remainders, clean fibers, phase invariance, exact general-rho Lagrangian class and invariant symbol isomorphism with m+n/4 degree and 2rho-1 drop. All output derivatives, physical-frequency tails, prescribed phases, bundle transitions, exact kernel and global surjectivity are proved.

source_result_coverage.source_scope: General-rho real stationary/clean estimates with every symbol derivative
General-rho phase representation, Fourier normal form and both prescribed-phase converses
General-rho leading Lagrangian symbols, exact quotient, kernel, global surjectivity and smoothing
Sharp remainder, endpoint and a clean cancellation example

source_density_degree_discrepancy: The page-16 general-rho quotient prints m+n/2. The same page defines scalar coefficient order m-n/4, and adjacent Theorem 25.1.10 uses m+n/4. The receiving lesson derives m+n/4 from half-density dilation and a point mass; no official publisher erratum is asserted.
related_programme_proof_navigation: The lesson links the completed composition, continuity, iterated-test or mixed-boundary arguments at their exact stated scopes. The fixed-endpoint counterexample and frequency-cell replacement retain their precise qualifications.
